attchmntText: Race Eco Chain Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Race Eco Chain submitted copies of newspaper advertisements to the Bombay Stock Exchange and National Stock Exchange on 14th November 2026. The advertisements were published in Financial Express and Jansatta. This submission complies with Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The documents relate to the un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended on 30th September 2026. The company scrip code is 537785 and symbol is RACE. The registered office is located in New Delhi. The corporate office is in Noida.

attchmntText: Race Eco Chain Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Race Eco Chain Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 13th November, 2026. The Board approved the Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended on 30th September, 2026. The company has enclosed the Standalone and Consolidated Un-audited Financial Results along with the Limited Review Report for the Quarter and Half year ended 30th September, 2026. The meeting concluded at 03:55 PM. The announcement was signed by Sunil Kumar Malik, Managing Director.
